label: Projected points per game
doctrine: How many points you think this offense scores per game in 2026.

label: Points per play
doctrine: Points scored per offensive play. Bridges PPG and pace — higher PPP means fewer plays needed for the same scoring environment (≈ PPG ÷ plays/G).

label: Projected plays per game
doctrine: How many offensive plays per game you expect (pace).

label: Projected pass rate
doctrine: Share of plays that are passes in 2026 (e.g. 54 = 54%). Not last year’s rate.

label: Upside play-volume boost
doctrine: In a strong year, how much higher could play volume run? 1.05 ≈ +5%.

label: Upside efficiency boost
doctrine: In a strong year, how much more efficient (yards/scores) could they be? 1.10 ≈ +10%.

label: Other target share
doctrine: Everyone not listed by name on the target pie. Named + Other should sum ≈ 100%.

label: Other rush share
doctrine: Everyone not listed by name on the rush pie. Named + Other should sum ≈ 100%.

label: Target share downside
doctrine: Soft healthy full-season target share (role intact, offense cold).

label: Target share (base)
doctrine: Base healthy-season target share. Named + Other on the team card should sum ≈ 100%.

label: Target share ceiling
doctrine: Realistic healthy ceiling with everyone else basically healthy. Ceilings do NOT need to sum to 100%.

label: Rush share downside
doctrine: Soft healthy full-season rush share.

label: Rush share (base)
doctrine: Base healthy-season rush share. Named + Other on the team card should sum ≈ 100%.

label: Rush share ceiling
doctrine: Realistic healthy rush ceiling. Ceilings do NOT need to sum to 100%.

label: Catch %
doctrine: Receptions ÷ targets over a full season.

label: Yards per target
doctrine: Receiving yards ÷ targets (overall receiving efficiency).

label: Completed air yards / catch
doctrine: How deep catches are completed (before YAC).

label: Yards after catch / reception
doctrine: YAC per catch — design + talent after the catch.

label: Rec TD rate (per target)
doctrine: Receiving TDs ÷ targets. Noisy — pin a season rate, not one hot streak.

label: Yards per carry
doctrine: Rush yards ÷ rush attempts (kneels excluded in model hist).

label: Rush TD rate (per carry)
doctrine: Rush TDs ÷ rush attempts. Heavily shrunk in the model — don’t overfit goal-line spikes.

label: Pass yards per attempt
doctrine: Passing yards ÷ pass attempts.

label: Pass TD rate (per attempt)
doctrine: Pass TDs ÷ attempts.

label: Interception rate
doctrine: INTs ÷ attempts.
